CustomField.description: The most of the org's data storage that AI Assist's own records may take, estimated at 2 KB a record. When reached, new chat messages are paused and only errors are logged until retention frees space. Between 5 and 100. Blank means no storage budget.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: AI Assist's share of data storage, 5 to 100. Blank means no budget.
CustomField.label: Storage Budget Percent
